messages:
Lina: Quick sync  proposing we run a focused "adapter onramp" for LangChain/LlamaIndex + AtlasCompute so the gateway listing can highlight hardware-accelerated inference. Target: prototype adapter, marketplace SKU, and a BrightBridge SI playbook in 10 days. Thoughts?
Omar: +1. From cloud marketplace POV we need clear billing units (per-1k tokens or per-session); also must include an AMI/container reference. I'll map the SKU fields.
Sofia: Runtime notes: Atlas has a fused-attention kernel on Ampere that reduces latency for medium seq lengths. We'll need a feature flag in the adapter manifest to opt into that path. Also think about quantization compatibility (8-bit vs 4-bit).
Ravi: SI (BrightBridge) input: the playbook should include SSO onboarding steps (SCIM), a checklist for VPC peering, and an ops runbook for failover to hosted model if dedicated capacity goes offline. Keep it <8 slides.
Lina: Good call. MarketplaceBot: please create a tracking ticket so we don't miss legal/logo approvals and AMI verification.
MarketplaceBot: Action created: MARKETPLACE-422 "Atlas x LangChain adapter listing" assigned to Omar. Due 2026-05-04.
Omar: For legal: Atlas requires a co-marketing agreement; Claire do you want to pick that up?
Claire: Yep. I'll start the legal intake and ping Atlas legal for a 1-pager. Also need brand usage guidelines.
Sofia: Technical ask: adapter manifest draft (YAML) snippet for the gateway (for docs). Putting a tiny example below for review: ```yaml
adapter_name: redwood-atlas-langchain
version: 0.1.0
supported_models:
  - llama-2-13b
  - llama-2-70b-quant
features:
  - streaming: true
  - kv_cache: true
  - atlas_accelerated: true
resources:
  cpu: 4
  gpu: g4dn.12xlarge
  min_memory_gb: 64
compatibility_tags:
  - langchain-agent
  - llamaindex-connector
```
Ravi: That manifest looks helpful. Can we add a telemetry hook field so SIs can opt in to per-route latency traces (PII-free)? We want to show token-level cost in demo.
Sofia: Sure. Add `telemetry_endpoint` and `telemetry_mode: anonymized`. We'll call it out in security review.
Lina: Risk register: 1) Atlas driver signing might block build on their infra, 2) BrightBridge needs a joint NDA to share customer sandbox, 3) marketplace approval calendar (EOD Wed cutoff).
Claire: I'll flag the NDA and logo usage in the legal ticket. Also confirm embargo window.
AtlasBot: Atlas infra note: Driver signing expected ETA 5 business days after ingestion of build artifacts. Recommend we stage a fallback container that uses our standard runtime for demo if signing delays occur.
Omar: I'll prepare the marketplace metadata template and drop it in the shared drive: https://drive.company/marketplace/atlas-adapter-meta. Will also include required screenshots (1024x512).
Ravi: Demo flow (BrightBridge): 1) Provision adapter from marketplace, 2) Run LangChain agent that calls an internal tool (simulate with local function), 3) Trigger capacity saturation and show staged failover to hosted model, 4) Show telemetry dashboard with anonymized token cost breakdown.
Lina: Owners: Omar (marketplace metadata & ticket), Sofia (adapter manifest & runtime validation), Ravi (SI demo & playbook), Claire (legal), AtlasBot (infra gating). I'll publish the sprint card and set daily 10-min stand.
Sofia: I'll run a compatibility smoke on LlamaIndex pipelines tomorrow and paste perf numbers in repo CI. If we see >2x latency improvement on Atlas for medium seqs, call it out in the marketplace blurb.
Ravi: BrightBridge can prepare a short canned dataset (anonymized support tickets) for the demo. I'll coordinate with their PM.
Lina: Nice. Let's aim to have a draft marketplace listing and demo video clip (30-45s) by day 7 so marketing can review. :movie_camera: :rocket:
Omar: Adding a small code snippet for integrators to test locally in docs (curl example):```bash
curl -X POST https://gateway.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/redwood-atlas-langchain/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"llama-2-13b","prompt":"Summarize: ...","stream":false}'
```
Claire: Thx. I'll chase legal and update the ticket with NDA status by EOD.
AtlasBot: Reminder: Atlas will run an infra smoke test on 2026-04-22 UTC. Please ensure signed artifacts are uploaded by 2026-04-20 UTC.
Lina: Perfect. Thanks all. Will capture notes in the sprint epic and set the kickoff for Monday 09:00 PT.
